prompt_md: Numbering the pages of a book, starting from page 1, takes exactly 1,002 digits in total. How many pages does the book have?
prompt_short: Page numbers from 1 use 1,002 digits. How many pages?
hint_md: Pages 1 to 99 don't use three digits each.
explain_intuition_md: Dividing 1,002 by 3 assumes every page number has three digits. Pages 1 to 9 use 9 digits and pages 10 to 99 use 180, which leaves 813 digits for three-digit pages: 271 of them. So the last page is 99 + 271 = 370.
